name: PDF Viewer
summary:
You can read PDF files and pin them to spatial.
The next time you launch the app, the PDF will be in the last location you used, and the last PAGE you viewed will be displayed.

This app offers only the PDF function among the features of the __Paste Photo VR__ app for free.

If you want to attach more types of media to the spatial, you can use the paid app
Visit ' __[Paste Photo VR]__ ' where you can use all kinds of files.

[Paste Photo VR]: https://www.meta.com/experiences/paste-photo-vr/8767138216715369/
